title: Create S3 bucket
content:
Create S3 bucket First, we will create an S3 bucket
Access AWS Management Console Find S3 Select S3 In the S3 interface, select Create bucket In the Create bucket interface
Bucket name, enter aws-first-cloud-journey AWS Region, select the region you want. For Object Ownership, select ACLs disabled (recommended) For Block Public Access settings for this bucket, leave the default. Check again and select Create bucket Finish creating S3 bucket to store source code website.

title: Introduction
content:
Overview Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) is an object storage service that provides on-demand scalability, ensuring high levels of data availability, security, and performance. best.
S3 is built to meet the needs of customers of all sizes and industries who can use this service to store and protect any amount of data.
S3 can be used for many use cases such as dataware house, websites, mobile apps, backup and restore, storage, enterprise applications, IoT devices, and data analytics great. In addition, Amazon S3 provides easy-to-use management features, so you can organize your data and configure access controls to meet the specific requirements of your business, organization, and requirements. compliance requirements.
Amazon S3 is designed for 99.999999999% (11 9’s) endurance and stores the data of millions of applications for companies worldwide.

title: Load data
content:
Download data We perform data upload (source code) to S3 bucket storage.
We download Source code to the device.
In the interface S3 bucket just created.
Currently, we see no object. Select Upload to download data (source code downloaded and unzipped) In the Upload interface
Select Add folder Select the unzipped folder Select Upload Wait for 5 minutes, and finish uploading data. Observe the uploaded folder.

title: Preparation
content:
Preparation steps In this lab, we create S3 bucket and then upload the data to prepare the host static website.
Create S3 bucket Download data

title: Enable static website feature
content:
Enable static website Next we will turn on the static website feature
In the S3 bucket interface, select Properties In the Properties interface
Scroll down and select Edit Static website hosting. In the Static website hosting interface
Select Enable for Static website hosting Hosting type, select Host a static website Index document, enter index.html Check again and select Save changes Complete enable static website hosting feature

title: Configuring public access block
content:
Configure public access block To be able to access the hosted website we will reconfigure Block Public Access
In the S3 bucket interface Select Permissions Currently, we see Block all public access is On In the Block public access interface Uncheck Block all public access Select Save changes Confirm confirm and select Confirm Complete Block public access configuration

title: Configuring public objects
content:
Configure public object In the S3 bucket interface
Select Permissions Drag the interface down
In the Access control list (ACL) section, select bucket owner enforced In the Object Ownership interface
Select ACLs enabled Select I acknowledge that ACLs will be restored Select Bucket owner preferred Select Save changes Finish Editing Object Ownership Back to the S3 bucket interface
Select Object Select the uploaded Folder. Select Actions Select Make public using ACL On the Make public page
Select Make public Complete public object configuration

title: Test website
content:
Check the website After successful installation and configuration. Next, we will check the website again.
Access the created S3 bucket.
Select Object Select S3-Website-main uploaded folder. Select index.html In the index.html details, we will choose Object URL Open a new browser tab and paste the Object URL of index.html.
We experience the website interface for tourism

title: Clean up resources
content: Clean up resources Empty S3 bucket Go to AWS S3 In the Bucket name list, select the bucket related to the lab. Select Empty In the Empty bucket page, confirm and select Empty Delete S3 Bucket Go to AWS S3 Select S3 bucket related to the lab. Select Delete bucket
